notes.title: 🕵️ New Chapter in the DETECTIVE Saga: Scene Crime is Here!
notes.content:
Put your deduction skills to the ultimate crime investigation game in DETECTIVE: Scene Crime!
Step into the role of a real detective and investigate five gripping crime scenes:

🏥 A suspicious death at the hospital
🚇 A subway train stained with blood
🛣️ A highway crash that doesn’t add up
🛒 A supermarket shooting with hidden motives
🏨 A wedding that ends in tragedy



There are no hints, no hand-holding, just you, your intuition, and your logic. Are you ready to connect the dots and uncover the truth?
🎮 Play now DETECTIVE Scene Crime on Steam Deck too!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656420?utm_source=jandu&utm_campaign=release&utm_medium=steamevent"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: DETECTIVE – The Test is OUT NOW on Steam!
notes.content:
The latest entry in the DETECTIVE series is here! 🕵️‍♂️


Put your deduction skills to the ultimate test in DETECTIVE – The Test, now available on Steam!

Step into the mind of a real detective and investigate three unique crime scenes:
🏠 A mysterious home
🚐 A secluded caravan park
☕ A coffee shop hiding dark secrets

There are no hints, no hand-holding, just you, your intuition, and your logic. Are you ready to connect the dots and uncover the truth?

🎮 Get it now and start solving mysteries like never before:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3473570?utm_source=event
